name: TLIBOT
summary: TLIBOT is a Mianyang robot manufacturer founded in 2012. It develops humanoid robots, mobile manipulators, lightweight collaborative robots and core components for automation applications. Its Tianzhen Z1 platform combines a modular humanoid body with articulated hands and an expressive neck, waist and shoulders, allowing customer-specific appearance and application adaptation.
